body: ## leptris adapter: `element_order` not populated and `map_all_content` targets stay nil With the default (leptris) XML adapter in lutaml-model 0.8.175, two kinds of mapping metadata are silently not populated at parse time. The nokogiri and ox adapters populate both. Consequences in consumers that rely on mixed-content fidelity (e.g. metanorma-document's document models rendered by metanorma-iso's DOCX pipeline): - `element_order` stays `nil` after `from_xml`, so mixed-content order walking falls back to attribute order; child elements and text interleave incorrectly (or elements get dropped by consumers that trust element_order). - `map_all_content to: :content` targets stay `nil` — raw inner markup is lost entirely. ### Repro ```ruby require "lutaml/model" class Body < Lutaml::Model::Serializable attribute :content, :string xml do element "body" map_all_content to: :content end end class Wrapper < Lutaml::Model::Serializable attribute :child, Body attribute :lang, :string xml do element "wrapper" map_element "body", to: :child map_attribute "lang", to: :lang end end Lutaml::Model::Config.configure { |c| c.xml_adapter = :leptris } Body.from_xml("plain").content # => nil (expected "plain") Wrapper.from_xml('axb').child.content # => nil Wrapper.from_xml('axb').child.element_order # => nil Lutaml::Model::Config.configure { |c| c.xml_adapter = :nokogiri } Body.from_xml("plain").content # => "plain" Wrapper.from_xml('axb').child.content # => "axb" Wrapper.from_xml('axb').child.element_order # => [Element(body...)] ``` ### Versions - lutaml-model 0.8.175 (latest release as of 2026-11-16) - leptris 1.9.424.0 - Workaround on the consumer side: `Lutaml::Model::AdapterScope.with(xml: :nokogiri) { Model.from_xml(xml) }` per parse (what metanorma-iso's DOCX pipeline now does — grind/1609 commit "docx: parse models under an adapter that keeps element_order").
title: leptris adapter: element_order not populated, map_all_content targets stay nil (nokogiri/ox clean)
